_note: Bands follow the NICHD pediatric terminology (Williams et al., Pediatrics 2012;129(Suppl 3):S153-S160) with two NICHD categories collapsed: toddler (13 months to 2 years) and early childhood (2 to 5 years) form one band, toddler and young child (366 to 2190 days). Neonate 0 to 27 days; infant 28 to 365 days; school-age child 2191 to 4380 days (NICHD middle childhood); adolescent 4381 to 6574 days.
